modalities.evidence: Computed Tomography (CT) images of the mediastinum and abdomen

output.population: Patients with mediastinal CT images (90 patients) and abdominal CT images (86 patients) labeled at the National Institutes of Health, Clinical Center.
output.summary: CT images of the mediastinum and abdomen with radiologist-marked lymph node positions, provided for developing and benchmarking computer-aided lymph node detection methods.
